subject: Rebook: platform + security walkthrough for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@nimbushealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 16:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood walkthrough next week?

Hi Camila / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick intro call today. We'd like to take the next step and get a live walkthrough focused on platform integration and an initial security review. Our initial ask is ~45 minutes so we can cover architecture and then a short Q&A with engineering.

Availability next week is a little tight because several folks are traveling, but we can do:
- Tue 7/13 10:00–10:45 PDT
- Wed 7/14 14:00–14:45 PDT

Can you confirm which slot works or propose alternatives? Also please send an agenda and any pre-read security artifacts.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Carter
Director of Platform Engineering
Nimbus Health
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough next week?

Hi Alex — great to hear. Either slot works from our side, but Marissa has a standing on-call rotation Wed afternoon. If you can do Tue 7/13 10:00 PDT that’s ideal. I've attached a short agenda (MVP-demo-agenda.pdf).

One quick note — if this will include security and procurement folks, we should bump the time to 60 minutes so we can cover the questionnaire and procurement timelines. Do you expect to bring those stakeholders?

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbushealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Carter <alex.carter@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough next week?

On Tue, Jul 13, 2027 at 08:07 Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alex — great to hear. Either slot works from our side...

Thanks Camila. We do need to include a couple more people from our side: security (me), procurement (Priya.procurement@nimbushealth.com), and platform ops (Samir Kaur). Also a heads-up — two of our stakeholders are traveling next week (returning 7/19). Can we please move this to the week of 7/19? Preferably 7/20 or 7/21 in the morning PDT. I've attached our security questionnaire so you can pre-scan (Nimbus-security-questions.xlsx).

If you can share a couple morning options on those dates we can lock in.

— Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Security Programs
Nimbus Health
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbushealth.com>, Alex Carter <alex.carter@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough next week?

Thanks for the heads-up, Priya — totally makes sense to include procurement and security. Dev and Rishi are copied to ensure we have the right technical cover.

Quick internal note (to Marissa/Dev/Rishi): two Nimbus stakeholders are traveling; they asked for week of 7/19, mornings PDT (7/20 or 7/21 preferred). Both security and procurement will join. Procurement will want procurement timelines and contract language; security will focus on data handling, KMS, and audit logs. Can you confirm whether we need 60 or 75 minutes for a full run-through? Also, Dev — if you could prepare a one-slide summary on private deployment options and expected lead times it will help procurement.

Camila (to Nimbus) — we can do 75 minutes to be safe. Proposed slots:
- Tue 7/20 09:00–10:15 PDT
- Tue 7/20 10:30–11:45 PDT
- Wed 7/21 09:00–10:15 PDT

I've included a calendar hold link for the first option; if none of these work tell me preferred times and we'll adjust. We'll also send a short pre-read addressing the security questions you attached.

Best — Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@nimbushealth.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood walkthrough next week?

Camila — thanks for the options and for looping in the right people. Tue 7/20 10:30–11:45 PDT works best for our team (gives our travelers an hour to clear into the office). Please send the updated invite and pre-read when ready.

Confirmed attendees from Nimbus: Alex Carter, Priya Shah, Priya.procurement@nimbushealth.com, Samir Kaur (Platform Ops).

See you then — Alex
